name: Real-time public transit app for the Bay Area and New York

mentions.name: Real-time public transit app for the Bay Area and New York
mentions.description: A real-time public transit app covering the Bay Area and New York, built on processed GTFS data. Destination search and routing are powered by geocoding from OpenStreetMap rather than Google Maps or other private data sources.
